structured.answer: I haven't decided anything and I'm not moving money. Of all the kinds on the list, מק"מ and government bonds (and maybe a קרן כספית) sound close to safe, so I'll ask my son and the bank about them, because the site gives no interest rates or fees to compare with my deposit.

stuck.why: It is called a קרן נאמנות, which I lost money in before, but it says 'סיכון נמוך'. I didn't know whether to trust it.
The suggestions are for employees (שכירים). There is nothing for a retired person with deposits, so I didn't know where to start.
Wall of indexes with English letters (MSCI, S&P). I got tired and worried and stopped reading properly.
Not sure what 'צמודה למדד' and 'קופון' mean here

not_found: Interest rates or returns to compare with my bank deposit
Anything about bank fees (עמלה), or whether the bank takes too much
Something for retirees with savings, rather than salaried workers
Who runs the site (only 'אתר אישי, לא מסחרי')
A sentence on which options are as safe as a deposit

findings.what: Grey text on a black background. The small descriptions under the headings were hard to read even with the page enlarged and my glasses on.
findings.where: Whole page, especially the card descriptions and subtitles

findings.what: No numbers on interest, returns or fees, so I can't tell whether anything gives more than my deposit or whether the bank takes too much.
The 'where to start' suggestions are only for employees. There is nothing for a retired person with deposits.
Half of the second screen is indexes with English letters. It felt like gambling and not for me, and it tired me out.
I don't know who is behind the site. It says only 'אתר אישי', no bank or official body.
Nowhere does it say plainly which options are safe like a deposit and which can lose money.
מק"מ appears twice with slightly different explanations, which confused me.
findings.where: כסף שוטף וקצר and במה הכסף מושקע
